# Load

`c.Load` calls the API's Load group. Get the load averages of target hosts.

## Methods

| Method                       | Returns                            | Permission  | Description                        |
| ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------- |
| [`Get(ctx, hostname)`](#get) | `*Response[Collection[LoadEntry]]` | `load:read` | Get the load averages of the host. |

### Get

```go
func (s *LoadService) Get(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
) (*Response[Collection[LoadEntry]], error)
```

Get the load averages of the host.

Reads the averages of the run queue over 1, 5 and 15 minutes.

It sends `GET /api/node/{hostname}/load`, and needs the permission `load:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

A host under a light load, `go run load.go get`:

```go
resp, err := c.Load.Get(ctx, target)
```
